points.description: Gives one valid privileged action a user process might attempt that the OS prevents (e.g., writing CR3 to change the page directory, writing EFLAGS to change status/interrupt flag, writing IDTR to relocate the IDT, or accessing kernel virtual addresses), with a brief explanation of what it would do or why it is blocked.
points.partial_credit: Half if the action is named but with no explanation, or the explanation is vague.

points.description: Gives a second, different valid privileged action from the model answer list, with a brief explanation of what it would do or why it is blocked.
points.partial_credit: Half if the action is named but with no explanation, or the explanation is vague.

rubric.notes: Full marks for two distinct valid privileged actions (CR3, EFLAGS, IDTR, kernel-address access or clearly equivalent register/memory accesses) with some explanation in any wording. Give part marks for an action named without explanation, or a vague but on-track description. Give no marks for actions that user code can do freely or that are unrelated (e.g., updating the PCB, which the question rules out).
